name: Laperva Keto Cola
descriptionHtml:
Laperva Keto Cola is a cola-flavoured soft drink designed for consumers looking for a zero-calorie beverage option. It combines a familiar cola flavour with selected functional ingredients, including branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), and is sweetened with stevia.

Each product contains 100 mg of BCAAs, a group of three essential amino acids: leucine, isoleucine and valine. These amino acids are included as part of the beverage's formulation. The product is also marketed as a zero-calorie drink, making it an option for consumers seeking a calorie-free cola alternative.

Laperva Keto Cola is sweetened with stevia and offers a convenient beverage option. Its cola flavour makes it suitable for consumers looking for an alternative to conventional cola drinks while following their preferred dietary choices.
features: Provides a cola-flavoured soft drink option.
Contains 100 mg of branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs).
Features a BCAA blend comprising essential amino acids.
Sweetened with stevia.
Marketed as a zero-calorie beverage.
howToUseHtml: Consume 1 can prior to or during exercise.
healthNotesHtml:
• Do not exceed recommended doses.
  • Do not use during breastfeeding, pregnancy, or for children.
  • Store the product in a cool, dry place in a well-sealed container.
  • The product is intended for adults only and should be used in a varied, balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.
  • If you are under medical supervision or taking any prescription medications, please consult your doctor before use.

name: Farah Secrets Creatine Monohydrate
descriptionHtml:
Farah Secrets Creatine Monohydrate is a micronized creatine supplement formulated for sports nutrition and fitness use. This product provides creatine monohydrate in a 300 g container.

The formula features micronized creatine monohydrate, a commonly used ingredient in sports nutrition supplements. Each serving provides 5 g of creatine monohydrate. The 300 g container provides 60 servings, with a serving size of one 5 g scoop.

Farah Secrets Creatine is designed for athletes, bodybuilders and fitness enthusiasts looking to include creatine monohydrate in their sports nutrition routine.

The product is presented as a micronized creatine monohydrate formula, with a clearly identified ingredient and serving quantity in the available product information.
features: Contains micronized creatine monohydrate.
Provides 5 g of creatine monohydrate per serving.
Supplied in a 300 g container with 60 servings.
Offers a convenient scoop-based serving format.
Designed for sports nutrition and fitness supplementation.
howToUseHtml: Mix one rounded teaspoon of Farah Secrets Creatine Powder with 8 Oz of Water or Your Favorite Beverage, or use as directed by a Physician or Licensed Nutritionist.
healthNotesHtml:
• Before Using This Product, Please Consider the Following Points:
  • Kidney or Liver Conditions: People With Kidney or Liver Disease, or a Medical History Related to These Conditions, Should Not Use Creatine Unless Under Direct Medical Supervision, as Creatine is Excreted Through the Kidneys.
  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: There Are Not Enough Studies Confirming the Safety of Creatine During Pregnancy or Breastfeeding, So it is Recommended to Avoid Use During These Periods.
  • Children Under 18: This Product is Intended for Adults and is Not Recommended for Minors Unless Under Specialized Medical Supervision.
  • Medication Interactions: If You Are Taking Prescription Medications, Consult Your Doctor Before Adding Any Dietary Supplement to Your Daily Routine.
  • Allergies: Although the Product Contains Only One Active Ingredient, Creatine, It is Recommended to Check the Product Label and Ensure There Are No Known Allergies.

name: Body Builder Boxing Gloves
descriptionHtml:
Body Builder Boxing Gloves are designed for boxing, kickboxing and fitness training sessions. Made with durable synthetic leather, these boxing gloves combine multi-layer foam padding, an adjustable Velcro wrist strap and a breathable inner lining to support comfort and hand protection during training.

The synthetic leather outer material provides a durable construction suitable for regular training activities. Multi-layer foam padding is incorporated to help absorb impact during punching exercises, while the adjustable Velcro strap provides a secure fit around the wrist and additional wrist stability.

The breathable inner lining helps manage moisture inside the gloves and supports a cooler, more comfortable feel during workouts. Its ventilated construction is also intended to help reduce moisture and odour.

Available in 10 OZ and 12 OZ variants.

Suitable for boxing, kickboxing and fitness training sessions.

name: Omron E3 Intense Pain Reliever
descriptionHtml:
The Omron E3 Intense Pain Reliever is a portable, drug-free TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) device designed to help relieve muscle and joint pain, stiffness and numbness. It uses Triple Action TENS technology to deliver controlled electrical stimulation through adhesive electrode pads placed on the skin near the area of discomfort. The device is intended for home use by adults and can be used on the back, shoulders, arms, legs, joints and feet.

The device uses three actions to support pain relief: helping block pain messages travelling through the nerves, triggering the release of endorphins (the body's natural pain-relieving chemicals), and supporting blood circulation through repeated muscle contractions and relaxation. TENS provides symptomatic pain relief and does not cure the underlying cause of pain.

Personalised Treatment Options
Omron E3 Intense offers six preset body-area programmes covering the back, shoulders, joints, arms, legs and soles or feet. It also features three massage modes: tapping, kneading and rubbing. Combined with 15 adjustable intensity levels, these options allow users to customise electrical stimulation according to their comfort and treatment preferences.

Reusable Electrode Pads and Convenient Operation
The device includes Long Life electrode pads that can be washed and reused up to 150 times when maintained according to the manufacturer's instructions. The adhesive pads are designed for repeated application to clean, dry and healthy skin. Both pads must be attached simultaneously for the therapy to function correctly.

The device features a display that shows the selected treatment information, intensity level and remaining session time. Its compact design and battery-powered operation make it suitable for home use and convenient to carry when travelling.

Treatment Duration and Operation
Each treatment session runs automatically for 15 minutes before the device switches off. The manufacturer recommends a maximum of two 15-minute sessions per sitting, up to three times daily. Users should follow the instruction manual for correct electrode placement, intensity adjustment and pad maintenance.

The package includes the main E3 Intense unit, electrode cord, Long Life Pads, pad holder, trial batteries, belt clip, soft pouch and instruction manual.
